design: Provenance-disjoint external validation. Train on one database, test on the other. Scaling fit on the training source only; the model never trains on any test-source compound. 505 mixed compounds dropped.
verdict: Above-chance but MODERATE cross-database transfer: external mean ROC-AUC 0.6918 (above random 0.5, below internal scaffold-disjoint 0.901). Indicates a genuine ChEMBL<->PubChem domain shift; reported as a limitation. Real transferable signal, not database-agnostic; the domain-shift penalty is itself evidence against leakage.
